data.narrative: The Module 07 review counted nine findings across four severities and separated structural authorization/data-contract risks from lower-severity hygiene issues. The reflection links role hierarchy, live authorization, tenant scoping, validation, atomic audit/activity, and evidence limits; 14 mocked tests and the Nest build passed, while live PostgreSQL/HTTP verification remains NOT EXECUTED.

dimension_scores.observation: The security review and role-mutation contract make actor, target, team scope, grant hierarchy, audit ordering, and negative tests explicit.
dimension_scores.evidence: The six-point hardening contract defines live OWNER/ADMIN checks, self-change rejection, role allow-listing, ADMIN-to-OWNER denial, atomic audit/activity, and boundary tests.

dimension_scores.observation: The review classifies all nine findings and follows authorization from route through guard, service, and database boundary.
dimension_scores.evidence: The reflection records 0 Critical, 3 High, 4 Medium, and 2 Low findings; it distinguishes current controls from hypothetical role-update risks.

dimension_scores.observation: The work builds on the existing findings and verification artifacts without unnecessary source or schema changes.
dimension_scores.evidence: The REFLECT deliverable reuses the Module 07 audit and fix contracts and adds only the reflection and evaluation record.

dimension_scores.observation: Claims remain bounded to source inspection, mocked tests, and build output; unavailable live enforcement is not represented as verified.
dimension_scores.evidence: The database reachability command returned False, and the reflection marks live PostgreSQL/HTTP and integration checks NOT EXECUTED.

dimension_scores.observation: The reflection connects audit hindsight, checklist controls, authorization-chain reasoning, decision callback, comprehension answers, and reproducible proof.
dimension_scores.evidence: The saved reflection includes the severity breakdown, ten-point living checklist, custom extensions, four evaluation answers, three comprehension answers, and test/build/database outputs.

strengths: Separates valid role values from authority to grant those roles.
Connects route guards, tenant scoping, service logic, database constraints, and audit/activity transaction boundaries.
Reports mocked verification separately from unavailable live PostgreSQL/HTTP evidence.
data.recommendation: When the isolated url_shortener_test database is reachable, run authenticated end-to-end checks for live role denial, role hierarchy, self-target rejection, and cross-team target isolation before making runtime security claims.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: The reflection explains that a TeamRole enum validates the allowed value set but does not authorize the actor to assign a role.
The review requires both actor authorization and target membership mutation to bind the same teamId.
The report distinguishes 14 passing mocked tests and a successful build from live database/HTTP checks that were not executed.

teaching_approaches.detail: Traced how a membership-only check, a valid privileged role value, and self-targeting could combine into promotion.
Walked from JWT principal through route metadata and live TeamRoleGuard lookup to service scoping and transactional persistence.
